fields.name: 📥 Heterogeneous RFID Ingress & CEL Normalization Monitor

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.reader_vendor') AS vendor, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.reader_id') AS reader_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.dock_portal') AS dock_portal, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.epc') AS epc, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.antenna') AS INTEGER) AS antenna, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.rssi') AS REAL) AS rssi_dbm, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.read_count') AS INTEGER) AS read_count FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'RawTagRead' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30

view.title: Normalized Edge RFID Ingress Stream (Hopeland, Zebra, Chafon, Marktrace)

fields.name: ⚠️ Edge RFID Reader Health & Weak Signal Incident Board

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.reader_vendor') AS vendor, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.dock_portal') AS dock_portal, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.alert_code') AS alert_code, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.details') AS details FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'ReaderHealthAlert' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

view.title: Edge Antenna Health & Weak Signal Alerts (< -75 dBm)
